dateAssessment: Working Darba dates use the YAML and Session 46 (DuFr): arrival August 8, 1748, then August 9 after the overnight. Earlier played Sendings are counted backward from that arrival: the second is the preceding night, and the first about a week earlier. The transcript supplies no independent civil date. The time extraction flags a conflict because those played journey events exceed the YAML’s one-day span; it does not assign missing elapsed time from drEnd. The session note instead dates Marcella’s reply to August 8; that competing reading remains unresolved.

watches.summary: First Sending explicitly mid-morning, about a week before the later contact.
Second Sending late at night, about a week later and one day before arrival.
Late-afternoon approach; pre-gates conversation resumed. Dock group arrives about an hour before sunset.
Evening entry, fifteen-minute tavern wait, dinner-time Green Leaf visit, inn reunion, and retrospective onboard trade.
watches.scope: Distinct Darba groups; no synchronization of their intervening actions

Most-day selling resumes after the flashback; about one hour, then fifteen minutes, remain before the scheduled sailing.
